A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-0.31401,51.64257.name: IVF London
-0.31401,51.64257.state: Caspian House, The Waterfront, Elstree, Borehamwood, WD6 3BS
-0.31401,51.64257.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

101.78000,36.62000.state: 青海省（2家） — 青海省西宁市城东区共和路2号
101.78000,36.62000.desc: A medical institution approved by China's National Health Commission to perform assisted reproduction. Approved for: ICSI — a single sperm injected into the egg; IVF with embryo transfer; insemination with the partner's sperm. All of its approvals are in formal operation. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Approval is compulsory in China and performing assisted reproduction without it is unlawful, so this list is a register rather than a directory of members. It names every approved institution in the country, which is more than almost any other state publishes. The address did not geocode, so this point sits at the centre of the province rather than at the institution.

-77.42280,39.44146.name: National Biodefense Analysis and Countermeasures Center (NBACC)
-77.42280,39.44146.state: 8300 Research Plaza, Fort Detrick, Maryland 21702, United States
-77.42280,39.44146.company: U.S. Department of Homeland Security Science and Technology Directorate Operated by Battelle National Biodefense Institute LLC
-77.42280,39.44146.desc: A BSL4 animal laboratory, operational. Run by U.S. Department of Homeland Security Science and Technology Directorate Operated by Battelle National Biodefense Institute LLC. It is categorised as a defense laboratory, working on both human and animal health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 980 SqM. Operational or announced: 2008. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-84.32000,33.80000.name: United States — CDC ART clinic reporting
-84.32000,33.80000.desc: US clinics performing IVF must report cycles and outcomes. Success rates depend heavily on which patients a clinic accepts, so a clinic can raise its published figures by declining harder cases, and the data cannot show you that.

23.72750,37.98380.name: Ministry of Rural Development and Food (Greece)
23.72750,37.98380.desc: Greece prohibits the cultivation of engineered crops and has used EU opt-outs to maintain it. Greece is also a centre of diversity for several Mediterranean crops, which is the stated basis for the position.

23.72750,37.98380.name: Greek cross-border fertility sector
23.72750,37.98380.desc: Greece receives large numbers of patients from countries with tighter rules, offering donor egg treatment with compensation and age limits that differ from those at home. Cross-border fertility care is a market created entirely by legal difference: the medicine is the same everywhere and the law is not.

-97.67890,30.50830.name: ViaGen — Przewalski's horse and endangered species cloning
-97.67890,30.50830.desc: Cloned Przewalski's horses from cells banked in the 1980s, reintroducing genetic diversity that had been lost from the living population entirely. The same company clones pet dogs and cats commercially. Conservation cloning and pet cloning are the same laboratory procedure sold to different buyers, and the commercial side is what pays for the capability.

-75.85000,43.16000.name: Marshall BioResources
-75.85000,43.16000.state: North Rose, New York — 5800 Lake Bluff Rd
-75.85000,43.16000.desc: The principal supplier of purpose-bred beagles and ferrets for research worldwide. Beagles are used because they are docile and uniform, which is a sentence worth sitting with. Dogs are covered by the US Animal Welfare Act, so unlike mice the numbers and the inspection reports are public — the transparency exists here and not for the animals used in far greater numbers.

5.12000,52.07000.name: CRV
5.12000,52.07000.desc: A Dutch-Flemish dairy cattle breeding cooperative, farmer-owned, running genomic selection across a large share of European dairy herds. Cooperative ownership is the counter-model to the corporate genetics companies, and it produces the same concentration of genetics by a different route.

7.14500,50.71800.name: Crop Trust
7.14500,50.71800.desc: An endowment that funds the world's crop collections in perpetuity, including the Svalbard vault and the CGIAR genebanks. It exists because genebanks are funded in three-year grants and seed collections die in the gaps: a collection missed for one regeneration cycle is lost, and cannot be reconstituted from anywhere. It is the answer to who pays for the material every argument on this map about landraces and wild relatives depends on.
